## kNN classification

```{r}
#Splitting Data

#setting seed for reproducability
set.seed(2005)

#making split
FullData_2025_parts <- FullData_2025 |> 
  initial_split(prop = 0.8)

#getting training data
FullData_2025_train <- FullData_2025_parts |>
  training() 

#getting testing data
FullData_2025_test <- FullData_2025_parts |>
  testing() 

#checking sizes could do seperately and avoid list
list(FullData_2025_train, FullData_2025_test) |>
  map_int(nrow)

#Cross Validation: from lecture 13
folds <- vfold_cv(FullData_2025_train, v = 5) #this makes the folds
folds
```

### All variable model

Make a kNN model using all your predictor variables

```{r}
#Recipe
knn_recipe_all <- recipe(Democracy ~ ., data = FullData_2025_train) |>
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) |> 
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())|>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors())

#Specification
knn_spec_all <- nearest_neighbor(neighbors=tune(),  weight_func = "rectangular") |>
  set_engine("kknn")|>
  set_mode("classification")

#Workflow
knn_wf_all<-workflow()|>
  add_recipe(knn_recipe_all)|>
  add_model(knn_spec_all)

```

#### Model tuning to find k using cv.

```{r}
#Tuning Grid: From lecture 13
knn_grid_all <- tibble(neighbors = seq(from=1, to=41, by=2))


##This is from lecture 1516
classification_metrics <- metric_set(accuracy, yardstick::sensitivity,yardstick::specificity )

knn_cv_all <- tune_grid(
  knn_wf_all,
  resamples = folds,
  grid = knn_grid_all,
  metrics = classification_metrics
)
cv_metrics_knn_all<-collect_metrics(knn_cv_all)
cv_metrics_knn_all

#Grabbing best k
best_k_all <- select_best(knn_cv_all, metric = "accuracy")
best_k_all
```
